speaker: Devotee (praying)
question: How shall rasa grow?
premises: Worshipped this, meditated this, pleased this — thus this rasa.
By thousand streams, in you, my — O Bhava — may it grow.
inference: May worship-meditation-pleasure rasa grow thousandfold in you.

option_choices.reason: Genitive my rasa (may my rasa grow); dative would orphan the streams.
Vocative O Bhava address; imperative would duplicate may-it-grow.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — intellect-lords garland?
premises: Bow to self abode of intellect-lords' garland.
To the Lord, to Sthāṇu, to you — serpent-sacrifice-thread-wearing.
inference: Bow to Sthāṇu Lord, serpent-threaded abode of intellects.

speaker: Devotee (begging medicine)
question: What medicine for ignorance?
premises: Of ignorance-darkness, the one medicine: remembrance of you.
O Bhava — by its giving, let grace be done in me.
inference: Remembrance of you is ignorance's one medicine; grant grace.

option_choices.reason: Vocative O Bhava (begging grace); imperative would duplicate let-it-be-done.
T1 its-giving (tattat = its, the medicine's giving); distributive this-and-that is same giving, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — fulfiller of ends?
premises: Bow to Īśa, fulfiller of all human ends.
To-be-offered: the homage even — whose here, of the wise?
inference: Bow to Īśa; even homage itself is his, of the wise.

option_choices.reason: Noun the-homage (to-be-offered homage); L2 reads noun, verb would duplicate bow.

speaker: Devotee (exulting)
question: What is conquered — having gained the jewel?
premises: By the immersed in terrible bhava-ocean, abode of suffering-fish.
Having obtained Śārva devotion-jewel: what not conquered?
inference: Having gained devotion's jewel from the ocean, all is conquered.

option_choices.reason: Accusative agreeing with jewel (Śārva devotion-jewel); nominative is same sense, T1 accusative kept.

speaker: Devotee (addressing)
question: Who knows you?
premises: Of unobstructed-pairless-steady-knowledge wealth: to-be-known you are indeed.
Who even are these who know you, O Dhūrjaṭi?
inference: You are knowable; yet who are these few who know you?

speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: Who conquers — qualityless, desireless?
premises: Qualityless even, of quality-knowers to-be-known, one conquers — unborn.
Desireless even, by nature: who is desires' supreme fruit.
inference: The qualityless unborn conquers; the desireless is desire's fruit.

speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: Whose is milk-ocean lordship?
premises: For Śrī-jewel-nectar gain, labored where not by which gods?
That milk-ocean lordship: yours alone, natural, O Lord.
inference: Gods labored for nectar elsewhere; milk-ocean lordship is yours naturally.

speaker: Devotee (bowing — Vṛtti-resolved)
question: Who blossoms, gives, where is bliss?
premises: Bow by devotion, for men's liberation: he blossoms (Vṛtti sphurate, not vocative).
O Bhava (Vṛtti he bhava!), to you (tubhyam), O Protector (rakṣāṃ kurvate) — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in abhava.
inference: He blossoms for liberation; O Bhava, protector, they give remembrance-praise: bliss everywhere.

option_choices.reason: Vṛtti resolves verb sphurate (he blossoms); dative rejected per 2026-11-04 record.
Vocative O-Protector kept; Vṛtti rakṣāṃ kurvate supports protector; dative open but T1 vocative kept.

speaker: Devotee (reasoning)
question: What remains to know or do?
premises: All-knowing, all-doing, all you are — thus, of knowers.
What knowable, what karma, O Lord — for endlessness, offered by you?
inference: You are all-knowing, all-doing, all; nothing remains but endless offering.
uncertainties: tvayārpyate: tvayā is instrumental formally (offered by you); L2 will render neutrally (offered up), flagged per T1 note.

option_choices.reason: tvayā is instrumental formally (offered by you); dative sense is L2 rendering, form kept honest.
